annotations.title: Get one ride within a park

description: Use this when a visitor names a ride that exists at more than one park: it finds the ride by ID, name or slug within one park and returns the same answer as parky_get_ride_facts.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

ride_id.description: Ride ID from parky_find_experience or parky_list_park_rides (for example magic-kingdom_seven-dwarfs-mine-train), or a ride name or slug when it is unique.

name: parky_get_park_ride
title: Get one ride within a park
